beats.label: S1 · Retirement broken
beats.text: Jefferson's daughters are abducted by 100 gangster Lala; Lynn releases him from his promise to give up the suit and Black Lightning returns.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the whole premise: he's back in the suit because his family is unsafe, not because he chose it.

beats.label: S1 · Anissa's powers wake
beats.text: The trauma of the abduction activates Anissa's strength and invulnerability; she starts testing them on street thugs and eventually confides in her mother.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Anissa's power arc is the second engine of the show; Lynn learning first sets up the Lynn-as-handler role.

beats.label: S1 · Tobias re-enters
beats.text: Gang boss Tobias Whale, disgraced years ago for supposedly killing Black Lightning, learns he's alive; his people paralyse Jennifer's boyfriend Khalil during a peace-march shooting.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season villain and plants Khalil's paralysis — the leverage Tobias later uses to turn him.

beats.label: S1 · Jennifer generates
beats.text: Startled at school, Jennifer discovers she generates electricity herself rather than channels it; Lynn's tests hint she is potentially far stronger than her father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jennifer's powers are qualitatively different from Jefferson's — the seed for her whole trajectory.

beats.label: S1 · Gambi's ASA past
beats.text: Jefferson learns his mentor Gambi is ex-ASA and was once a spotter for the Freeland experiment that produced the meta-kids; trust shatters before slowly rebuilding.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Recontextualises Gambi and the meta-kids as a single conspiracy, which then drives the rest of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Thunder and Painkiller
beats.text: Anissa suits up as Thunder to fight beside her father; Tobias buys Khalil's loyalty with a spinal implant that lets him walk and deliver paralysing toxin as an assassin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Both heroes and Tobias's enforcer take their final S1 form here; Painkiller is now a named threat.

beats.label: S1 · Proctor down, briefcase open
beats.text: Jefferson exposes the meta-kid pods to the public and Gambi kills rogue ASA head Proctor; Tobias uses Proctor's severed thumbs to open his hidden briefcase.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The public reveal reshapes Freeland politics, and the briefcase is the direct hook into next season's threat.

cliffhanger.text: The ASA's meta-kid conspiracy is public and Jefferson and Anissa are hailed as heroes, but Tobias has just opened Martin Proctor's briefcase — and whatever the government hid inside is now his to use against Black Lightning.
questions: What did Proctor keep in that briefcase?
Now that Jefferson and Anissa are public heroes, who else in the ASA is watching?
Will Jennifer accept the powers she just learned she has, or keep chasing a normal life?

characters.name: Jefferson Pierce / Black Lightning
characters.line: Garfield High principal and electrokinetic hero, out of retirement to protect his family and Freeland.

characters.name: Anissa Pierce / Thunder
characters.line: Older daughter and activist; super-strength and invulnerability, now openly suited up alongside her father.

characters.name: Jennifer Pierce
characters.line: Younger daughter; late-blooming electrical powers she can generate herself, still reluctant to embrace them.

characters.name: Lynn Pierce
characters.line: Jefferson's ex-wife and neuroscientist; back in his orbit, studying Green Light and the meta-kid pods.

characters.name: Peter Gambi
characters.line: Jefferson's tailor and mentor, exposed as ex-ASA who hid his role in the Freeland experiment to shield the family.

characters.name: Tobias Whale
characters.line: Albino gang boss of the 100 and disgraced ex-politician; wounded but back, and now holds Proctor's briefcase.

characters.name: Khalil / Painkiller
characters.line: Jennifer's paralysed boyfriend, walking again thanks to Tobias's toxin-delivering spinal implant; now his assassin.

characters.name: Bill Henderson
characters.line: Freeland cop newly promoted to Deputy Chief; a Black Lightning ally who doesn't know Jefferson is under the mask.

characters.name: Lala / Latavius
characters.line: Resurrected 100 lieutenant whose murder victims manifest as living tattoos on him; kept in line by a trigger phrase from Tobias.

beats.label: S2 · Odell arrives
beats.text: The ASA sends agent Percy Odell to clean up the Freeland scandal; Lynn takes charge of the meta-kid pods as scientists try to save the kids inside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Odell replaces Proctor as the ongoing federal antagonist and Lynn's tie to him drives the season.

beats.label: S2 · Anissa's shadow war
beats.text: Anissa moonlights as a vigilante robbing drug dealers to fund the Freeland clinic; Jefferson pushes back on her methods and she moves out rather than stop.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The methodological split between Jefferson and Anissa is the seed of her later underground identity.

beats.label: S2 · Khalil breaks with Tobias
beats.text: Tobias admits it was his men who paralysed Khalil, then sends the mercenary Cutter after him and Jennifer when Painkiller balks at killing Reverend Holt.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Khalil turning on Tobias is what puts him and Jennifer on the run and sets up his death.

beats.label: S2 · Grace, the shapeshifter
beats.text: Grace vanishes leaving schizophrenia medication behind; Anissa realises Grace has been a shapeshifter all along, struggling to control it, and starts hunting for her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Grace's reveal and disappearance is the unresolved thread Anissa carries into next season.

beats.label: S2 · Khalil dies
beats.text: Cutter delivers Khalil to Tobias, who tears out his spinal implant; Khalil dies in hospital as Jennifer says goodbye, hardening her against the world.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Khalil's death is the emotional detonation that sends Jennifer into the suit and toward killing Tobias.

beats.label: S2 · Lightning suits up
beats.text: Enraged over Khalil, Jennifer debuts as Lightning and tries to execute Tobias; Jefferson talks her down and Tobias is sent to the Pit meta-prison instead.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Third Pierce hero is now active; the choice not to kill is what earns Odell the leverage to draft them next.

beats.label: S2 · Odell holds the strings
beats.text: With Tobias caged, Odell reveals he knows every Pierce identity and 'swears them in' as ASA weapons against an incoming Markovian invasion.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The direct handoff into next season: identities known, family conscripted, foreign war looming.

cliffhanger.text: Tobias is behind bars but Odell has revealed he knows every secret identity in the family, and he is drafting the Pierces as ASA soldiers against a Markovian invasion he says is already coming.
questions: Can the Pierces fight for the same agency that experimented on their neighbours?
What is Markovia actually coming to Freeland for?
Where has Grace gone, and does she still remember who Anissa is?

characters.name: Jefferson Pierce / Black Lightning
characters.line: Trying to hold his family together outside Odell's grip; still Freeland's public hero.

characters.name: Anissa Pierce / Thunder
characters.line: Openly heroic and separately robbing dealers for the clinic; estranged from Jefferson over methods.

characters.name: Jennifer Pierce / Lightning
characters.line: Newly suited after Khalil's death; volatile, angry, and demonstrably willing to kill.

characters.name: Lynn Pierce
characters.line: Running the pod-kid program from inside the ASA; tolerating Odell to save the children.

characters.name: Peter Gambi
characters.line: Trusted advisor again; faked his own death mid-season to expose Fowdy's killers.

characters.name: Agent Percy Odell
characters.line: New ASA controller in Freeland; ruthless federal handler who now owns the Pierces' secret.

characters.name: Tobias Whale
characters.line: Briefly free, then imprisoned in the Pit metahuman jail after Jennifer's near-execution.

characters.name: Khalil / Painkiller
characters.line: Deceased; killed when Tobias tore out his spinal implant.

characters.name: Grace Choi
characters.line: Anissa's girlfriend, revealed as a shapeshifter with mental-health struggles; currently missing.

characters.name: Bill Henderson
characters.line: Deputy Chief; ally who now knows Jefferson is Black Lightning.

beats.label: S3 · Freeland under lockdown
beats.text: Odell puts Freeland under martial law hunting Markovian metas; Jefferson and Lynn are detained while Anissa smuggles metas out of the perimeter as Blackbird.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's shape — occupation, resistance, and Anissa's new alias.

beats.label: S3 · Odell weaponises Jennifer
beats.text: Odell keeps Jennifer close by lying that Markovians killed Nichelle and giving her a new suit; she works for the ASA for months before catching him in the lies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Jennifer's willing collaboration with Odell is the season's slow-burn betrayal; when she flips it changes the war.

beats.label: S3 · Khalil, reprogrammed
beats.text: Lynn discovers the ASA revived Khalil as a chipped Painkiller assassin; TC firewalls the killer programming so the real Khalil can surface, but he keeps his distance from Jennifer.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Khalil comes back, but as a split person under an ongoing kill switch — a live thread going forward.

beats.label: S3 · Lynn hooked, Gravedigger revealed
beats.text: Lynn's meta-serums quietly hook her on Green Light; Gravedigger, the Markovian super-soldier, is revealed to share Jefferson's DNA — the Pierces have family they never knew about.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Lynn's addiction is a hidden fuse for the next season, and Gravedigger reframes the family's origin.

beats.label: S3 · Lady Eve returns
beats.text: A resurrected Lady Eve seizes what's left of the 100, takes Lala under her mind-control program, and quietly gains custody of Proctor's briefcase.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Post-Tobias vacuum starts filling; Lala plus the briefcase is the direct pickup into next season.

beats.label: S3 · War in the streets
beats.text: Gravedigger's meta-boosted invasion tears Freeland open; Henderson is killed helping Jefferson breach the Pit and Lynn kills Commander Williams in self-defence.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Henderson's death is the emotional wound Jefferson carries into the next season.

beats.label: S3 · Odell falls, hidden fires
beats.text: Jefferson delivers Odell to a congressional committee with Proctor's briefcase as evidence; Gravedigger survives the Pit blast, Grace is comatose, and Lynn keeps using.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames the tidy public victory against the private wreckage the family walks into next.

cliffhanger.text: Freeland is officially free, Odell in a cell and the ASA exposed to Congress. But Henderson is dead, Grace is in a coma, Lynn is quietly still on Green Light, and out in the shadows Lady Eve is rising with a mind-controlled Lala.
questions: Can Lynn hide her Green Light habit from her family?
Where does Tobias resurface now that the ASA is gone?
What does Lala want with Proctor's briefcase?

characters.name: Jefferson Pierce / Black Lightning
characters.line: Freeland's public hero again, but grieving Henderson and increasingly willing to be harder about it.

characters.name: Anissa Pierce / Thunder / Blackbird
characters.line: Dual identity now — sanctioned hero and underground resistance leader; wife-to-be to a comatose Grace.

characters.name: Jennifer Pierce / Lightning
characters.line: Broke with Odell after uncovering his lies about her mother; still learning how far her powers can push.

characters.name: Lynn Pierce
characters.line: Publicly won her war on the ASA; privately hooked on the Green Light serums she used on herself.

characters.name: Peter Gambi
characters.line: Resistance strategist and family gadget-maker, now partnered with the technopath TC.

characters.name: Khalil / Painkiller
characters.line: ASA-revived assassin whose killer programming is firewalled from the real Khalil; distancing himself from Jennifer.

characters.name: Grace Choi
characters.line: Anissa's wife-to-be; in a coma after Gravedigger's attack, still an open thread.

characters.name: Bill Henderson
characters.line: Killed helping Jefferson breach the Pit; the wound that reshapes Jefferson's tactics going forward.

characters.name: Tobias Whale
characters.line: Escaped the Pit and vanished; a fugitive with no visible base.

characters.name: Lala / Latavius
characters.line: Resurrected again and mind-controlled by Lady Eve.

beats.label: S4 · Grief and a darker Jefferson
beats.text: With Henderson dead, Jefferson vents his grief by permanently maiming criminals and secretly hunting a shooter down himself, worrying Lynn and Gambi.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes that Jefferson is the season's own problem, not just Tobias — the arc bends around him crossing lines.

beats.label: S4 · Tobias goes legit
beats.text: Tobias resurfaces as a Freeland philanthropist funding Lynn's clinic and pursuing the mayor's seat, while secretly harvesting metahuman genes for his real project.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Whole final showdown builds from Tobias's public respectability, so the misdirection has to be planted early.

beats.label: S4 · Jennifer comes back wrong
beats.text: Jennifer overloads and dissipates into energy in the ionosphere; Jefferson and Gambi rebuild her into a new body, but the person who returns looks and acts different.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The 'new Jennifer' plants the mystery that pays off at the season's climax.

beats.label: S4 · Grace wakes, Khalil resurfaces
beats.text: Grace wakes from her coma and marries Anissa; separately, Khalil — still Painkiller — dismantles an ASA remnant run by Odell's daughter Maya.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ties off two S3 threads and reintroduces Khalil as his own operator, not a Pierce satellite.

beats.label: S4 · Emitter and frame-up
beats.text: Tobias completes an Emitter powered by power-negating DNA, frames Jefferson for embezzlement, has Lynn arrested, and takes the Freeland mayor's seat.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Tobias's endgame — power neutralisation plus political cover — puts the family at its lowest point.

beats.label: S4 · The real Jennifer returns
beats.text: A trip to the ionosphere exposes the 'Jennifer' they've been living with as an entity that stole her DNA; the real Jennifer emerges and absorbs the imposter.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the season's biggest mystery and puts the true Jennifer back in the fight for the finale.

beats.label: S4 · Torch passed, Lala returns
beats.text: Jefferson kills Tobias in Tori Tower, hangs up the suit to advise his daughters, and plans to remarry Lynn; below, Lala revives beside Tobias's body, laughing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the series' central conflict while leaving the one thread the family doesn't know is still loose.

cliffhanger.text: The Pierces have won — Tobias dead, Jefferson stepping down as Black Lightning, the family whole and the torch passing to Anissa, Jennifer and Grace. But under Tori Tower, Lala has just revived beside Tobias's corpse, laughing, the one loose thread no one knows is still pulling.
questions: What does Lala do now that the man who controlled him is dead?
Can Anissa, Jennifer and Grace hold Freeland without Jefferson in the suit?
Is Khalil truly free now that his memories of the Pierces have been wiped?

characters.name: Jefferson Pierce
characters.line: Retired from the suit after killing Tobias in self-defence; now an advisor to his daughters and remarrying Lynn.

characters.name: Anissa Pierce / Thunder / Blackbird
characters.line: Married to Grace and one of Freeland's new senior heroes.

characters.name: Jennifer Pierce / Lightning
characters.line: Restored to herself after the ionosphere entity was absorbed; ready to lead alongside her sister.

characters.name: Lynn Pierce
characters.line: Through her addiction and back to full clinical work; remarrying Jefferson.

characters.name: Peter Gambi
characters.line: Semi-retired mentor, handing the tech duties to TC.

characters.name: Grace Choi / Wylde
characters.line: Awake, married to Anissa, and now openly suited as the beast-form hero Wylde.

characters.name: Khalil / Painkiller
characters.line: Freed of his ASA kill code — at the cost of all his memories of the Pierce family.

characters.name: TC
characters.line: Technopath and Gambi's successor at the tech console.

characters.name: Tobias Whale
characters.line: Dead; killed by Jefferson in the fall from Tori Tower.

characters.name: Lala / Latavius
characters.line: Just revived beside Tobias's corpse — the one loose thread the family hasn't accounted for.
